games.description: Sark explores the twelve-game spoopy anthology and its castle story. The solo visits range from detective work and platforming to a children’s party, alien ice cream, monster raising, and microgames; EDEN continues in the recovered upload after a computer crash.
games.title: Dread X Collection 3

games.description: Sark plays the seven horror shooters and investigates the abandoned arctic research base. The solo run begins with ghost photography, continues through diseased animals and bizarre worlds, and ends with a demon-hunting priest and the base’s finale.
games.title: Dread X Collection: The Hunt

games.description: A solo test of a Siberian shooter with dinosaurs. Sark tackles the soldier mission and helicopter attack, faces a T-Rex, then experiments with multiplayer modes populated by bots.
games.title: Ghostwinter

games.description: Sark learns the hunting and tracking systems, spends rather a lot of time testing the Jeep on mountains and returns later to complete the Hollywood buck mission.
